method: Built-in image_gen edits using the approved iFranchise brandmark as an insert reference

assets.prompt: Use case: compositing / precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target: an existing iFranchise editorial illustration. Image 2 is the approved brandmark insert, with transparent background. Make ONE very small local edit: Print one small brandmark on the upper-middle of the white document held by the seated man. It is printed on the document and follows the paper's slight perspective, not floating. Keep the tabletop miniature store unchanged.. Reproduce the exact distinctive iF brandmark geometry from image 2, not ordinary typed letters. The mark should be approximately 3–4% of the entire canvas width (smaller if needed to fit the existing object), low-contrast muted purple matching image 1, a quiet detail naturally printed/etched on the specified surface, not a focal point. Preserve the original people, faces, hands, clothing, composition, illustration style, canvas framing, linework, and ALL original colours and background; change nothing else. No external corner logo, no floating watermark, no extra brandmarks, no wordmark or text, no new decorative badge. The final must be the complete existing 3:2 landscape illustration with just this discreet integrated logo. Output a single image.
